language_prompt: 🌐 Bot language Current: {current} Pick a language below. (Full localization is in progress — some messages will stay Ukrainian for now.)
lang_confirm_prompt: 👋 Hi! I'm KusWise — your calorie tracker. I'll talk to you in English (detected from your Telegram). If you'd prefer Ukrainian, you can switch below.
onboarding.intro:
👋 Hi! I'm KusWise Bot — your personal nutrition genie.

To calculate your ideal calorie target I need to learn a little about you. Six quick questions, takes about a minute. Ready? 🚀
onboarding.ask_age: 1/6 🎂 How old are you? Just the number (10–100). I won't tell anyone.
onboarding.ask_sex: 2/6 🚻 Sex? Needed for the formula — different metabolism.
onboarding.ask_weight: 3/6 ⚖️ How much do you weigh? (in kilograms) Decimals OK (e.g. 75.5). Scales don't lie. Neither does the bot.
onboarding.ask_height: 4/6 📏 How tall are you? (in centimeters) Whole number, 100–250. Don't add 'with shoes'.
onboarding.ask_gym: 5/6 🏋️ How often do you train per week? Be honest. Couch doesn't count.
onboarding.invalid_number: Hmm, that doesn't look like a number. Try again. 🙂
onboarding.age_range: Age should be between 10 and 100. Try again, please. 🎂
onboarding.weight_range: Weight should be between 30 and 300 kg. Try again. ⚖️
onboarding.height_range: Height should be between 100 and 250 cm. Try again. 📏
onboarding.custom_cal_prompt: Enter your own calorie target (whole number, 1000–6000):
onboarding.custom_cal_range: Calories should be between 1000 and 6000. Try again. 🙂
onboarding.done: 🎉 All set, {name}! I know everything I need now. Send me 📸 a meal photo or 📝 a text description — I'll count it. Commands are in the «/» menu, your profile is at /profile.
onboarding.required: Let's get to know each other first 👋 Tap /start — I'll ask a few questions and calculate your target.
onboarding.ask_tz: 🌐 What's your timezone? This sets when your day rolls over and when the daily summary fires. If your zone isn't in the list, pick «Other» and type the IANA name.
onboarding.tz_custom_prompt: Enter your timezone in IANA format, e.g.: Asia/Tokyo, America/Chicago, Australia/Sydney. Full list: en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_tz_database_time_zones
onboarding.tz_invalid: Didn't recognize that zone 🤔 Check the spelling — it should be Region/City, like Europe/Madrid or Asia/Tokyo.
